Processing and Milling

Raw Tribulus terrestris material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Next, we clean, grade and dehydrate it. Our gokhru powder 100 mesh grade is then milled and sieved to 80-100 mesh. This fine texture blends evenly in powder and liquid formulations. Our tribulus terrestris powder bulk manufacturer work follows food hygiene practices under our FSSAI licence. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Key Specifications and Technical Standards

Food and supplement makers need clear parameters. Here are our standard product specifications:
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh, for smooth blending.
  • Moisture Content: Below 7.0% to prevent caking.
  • Purity: Plain gokhru seed powder with no additives.
  • Appearance: Fine, uniform greenish-brown powder.
Stored cool and dry, the powder has a shelf life of 24 months. Our packing also protects it from humidity in transit.
